title: Model Governance Manager (AI)
description:
We are seeking a technically accomplished Model Governance Manager to take ownership of the operational delivery and continuous improvement of AI and Machine Learning governance processes within a global information and analytics organisation.

This position sits at the intersection of Data Science, Model Risk Management and Responsible AI, ensuring that AI/ML models are developed, reviewed, approved and monitored within a robust, scalable governance framework.

The successful candidate will combine a hands-on background in Data Science or Machine Learning with practical knowledge of AI governance, model validation and regulatory requirements.

This is an opportunity to influence how AI governance is implemented across a large organisation, supporting responsible innovation while enabling technical teams to develop and deploy AI solutions effectively.

Key Responsibilities

AI & Model Governance

  • Own and manage day-to-day AI and Machine Learning model approval and review processes.

  • Maintain centralised inventories of AI/ML models and third-party AI software across development and production environments.

  • Act as the primary contact for data scientists, model owners and AI software requesters navigating governance requirements.

  • Ensure appropriate model documentation, validation, risk assessments and approvals are completed throughout the model lifecycle.

  • Monitor governance activities and escalate risks, issues and compliance gaps where appropriate.

Governance Framework & Risk Management

  • Support the development and implementation of AI governance policies, standards and model risk assessment methodologies.

  • Ensure governance processes align with relevant regulations and recognised standards, including the EU AI Act and applicable AI risk management frameworks.

  • Support internal audit, regulatory compliance and risk management activities.

  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation and governance records.

  • Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to promote responsible AI practices.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to streamline model approval workflows and improve governance efficiency.

  • Develop and enhance governance tools supporting model inventories, approvals, monitoring and reporting.

  • Introduce automation and self-service capabilities where appropriate.

  • Track and report on model portfolio health, governance effectiveness and approval turnaround times.

  • Contribute to the longer-term development of a scalable AI governance operating model.

Essential Requirements

  • Hands-on Data Science or Machine Learning background, including practical experience developing, training, validating or deploying ML models.

  • Experience in AI governance, model risk management, model validation or a closely related discipline.

  • Strong understanding of the ML lifecycle, including model development, testing, validation, deployment and monitoring.

  • Experience implementing, managing or improving structured operational processes.

  • Understanding of AI risks, model controls, regulatory requirements and Responsible AI principles.

  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage approval workflows, maintain accurate records and coordinate multiple stakeholders.

  • Excellent communication skills, particularly when translating technical concepts into practical governance requirements.

  • Ability to independently manage operational responsibilities while supporting strategic framework improvements.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience managing AI/model inventories and formal model approval processes.

  • Familiarity with MLOps, model monitoring or model lifecycle management platforms.

  • Practical experience using Python, SQL or other relevant Data Science technologies.

  • Knowledge of the EU AI Act, NIST AI Risk Management Framework or ISO/IEC 42001.

  • Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models and associated governance challenges.

  • Exposure to governance workflow automation, reporting dashboards or self-service approval tools.

  • Experience developing AI governance policies, model risk frameworks or validation standards.

  • Background in regulated industries, financial services, technology, healthcare or scientific research.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will have started their career in a hands-on Data Science, Machine Learning Engineering or Quantitative Modelling position before developing expertise in AI governance, model validation or model risk management.

They will understand both how AI models are built and deployed and how to establish effective controls around their use.

Suitable backgrounds could include:

  • AI / Model Governance Manager

  • Model Risk Manager

  • AI / ML Model Validation Manager

  • Responsible AI Manager with a technical background

  • Data Scientist transitioning into AI governance

  • ML Engineer with model governance or risk management experience

Importantly, this role requires someone comfortable taking ownership of operational governance processes rather than focusing exclusively on strategy, policy development or advisory work.

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to support the responsible adoption of AI within a globally recognised information and analytics business, working alongside Data Science professionals and governance stakeholders.

The role provides exposure to evolving AI technologies, regulatory frameworks and opportunities to improve governance through automation and scalable processes.

The organisation offers a collaborative working environment, professional development opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package.

Robert Walters Operations Limited is an employment business and employment agency and welcomes applications from all candidates
